For a tree, primitive discrete vector field incidences form matching complex of the Hasse incidence graph: acyclicity automatic. Each 2-edge arm has incompatible chain y_i-z_i-w_i, so its subcomplex without center incidence x_i is an edge plus isolated vertex (integral S^0). The join B of n copies is an integral S^(n-1) whose factor permutations act via sign. Link of each x_i includes z_i,w_i in that arm and remaining A_j; its inclusion into B is integral homotopy equivalence. Distinct x_i are incompatible and added relative cones therefore give H_n(K,B)=Z^n with the sign-permuted action, and the connecting map is sign-twisted augmentation to H_(n-1)(B)=Z. Kernel is sign tensor ker(sum), rank n-1 in degree n; surjectivity kills B degree n-1, no torsion or others. Character sign(sigma)(f(sigma)-1). For n=4 transposition f=2, sign=- yields char -1; a 4-cycle f=0, sign=- yields char +1. Inspected checker enumerates all 152 permutations across n=2..5 and mod2 homology n=2..4, but did not independently run this script.
